## Lead Generation - Full Outreach Pipeline

**Flow:** Form/Schedule > Apify Scrape > Deduplicate > Website Enrichment > AI Scoring > AI Email Gen > Send > Log

**Setup Required:**
1. Configure Apify credentials and actor ID
2. Configure Google Sheets (3 tabs: All Leads, Qualified Leads, Errors)
3. Configure SMTP credentials for Send Email node
4. Configure OpenAI API key
5. Update Schedule Config node with your default industry/location
6. Update the Offer Description in both form and Schedule Config

## AI Scoring
Scores leads 0-10.
Only leads scoring 7+ get personalized outreach.
All leads logged to All Leads sheet regardless of score.

## Email Outreach
Use SMTP credentials (SendGrid, Mailgun, etc.)
DO NOT use personal Gmail for cold outreach.
Follow-up emails stored in Qualified Leads sheet for manual or scheduled sends.

Thanks for asking
